result.description: Corporate card, spend management and finance platform for businesses (cards, expenses, payments, budgets, team management).
result.auth_detail: Customer user token (Bearer), created by an account or card admin in the dashboard. OAuth2 Authorization Code Grant for partner apps acting on other Brex accounts; client ID and secret issued only by contacting developer support. Client Credentials Grant for the onboarding API only.
result.access_detail: User tokens need an existing Brex customer account with admin access and an accepted developer API agreement. No public developer sandbox: staging "is not a sandbox". OAuth for multi-tenant apps needs a client ID and secret from Brex developer support. No pricing or plan gate for the API was found.
result.api_notes: REST/OpenAPI. Team API covers users, locations, departments, titles, cost centers, cards, legal entities, roles and companies. Transactions and Payments APIs also exist. Onboarding, Expenses, Budgets and Webhooks were not verified on the pages read.
result.blocker: No self-serve developer account or sandbox. Credentials exist only inside a Brex customer account, and OAuth for a multi-tenant app needs a client ID and secret from Brex developer support.
